🥛 Milk ribbon sweeping diagonally across the foreground, overlapping the pack’s lower edge without covering the logo.
The white ribbon brings the motion forward. That controlled overlap makes the pack feel suspended between the two liquids while keeping the brand easy to read.

The Second World

LOWER HALF

Ivory paper with subtle fibers and abundant negative space. The lower world must stay visibly attached Never isolate it as a separate portal, window, stage, platform, or floating vignette unless it clearly comes from the photo.

SECOND WORLD LOGIC

Ask: if this structure became touchable, usable, enterable, or changeable, what would it naturally become? Create one image-specific interaction. short handwritten English caption (2-6 words) based on the action. Natural, light, slightly witty. Spell it correctly. No inspirational quotes and no fixed "Same..., different..." phrasing.

裁剪。

下半部分

Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second, 16:9 cinematic action sequence: a mechanical shrine maiden controls a raging inferno inside a Japanese shrine courtyard at night. Photorealistic environments, intricate mechanical textures, spectacular fire effects, aggressive action-film cinematography, disturbing digital glitches and dense electronic noise.

REFERENCE IMAGE — CHARACTER IDENTITY
The attached character sheet shows multiple views and component details of ONE character. Generate only one shrine maiden.
Preserve her exact design: tall, slender mechanical body, black metallic armor, vermilion ornamentation, elongated mask, pale metallic lower face, rigid rectangular head attachments, articulated mechanical fingers, hanging talisman-like panels, exposed cables and distinctive platform footwear.

Maintain the same silhouette, proportions, materials and costume throughout every shot. Use the reference only for character identity. Do not reproduce the character-sheet layout, labels, exploded parts or gray background.

SETTING
An empty Japanese shrine courtyard at midnight. Clearly visible vermilion torii gates, a wooden main sanctuary, stone lanterns, stone paving, sacred shimenawa ropes and towering cedar trees. Wet surfaces reflect the firelight. Smoke, embers and wind fill the courtyard. Keep the shrine architecture recognizable throughout the sequence.

COLOR AND ATMOSPHERE
Deep blacks, vermilion red, pale metal and blazing orange-white fire. Strong contrast, dark atmospheric depth, sharp mechanical detail and realistic cinematic lighting. The shrine maiden feels composed, sacred and threatening.
SHOT SEQUENCE

0.0–2.0 seconds — IMMEDIATE FIRE REVEAL
Begin inside a violently erupting wall of fire.
The camera punches through foreground flames and rushes toward the shrine maiden’s mask, ending in an intense close-up.
Her head remains perfectly still as flames surge behind her. Firelight travels across the black armor and red patterns. Hanging panels and cables react to the wind.
The opening must have immediate visual impact.
2.0–5.0 seconds — SHRINE COURTYARD
Hard cut to a wide, ground-level tracking shot with a 24mm lens.
The camera races sideways just above the wet stone paving, passing a stone lantern in the foreground and revealing the shrine maiden standing between the torii gate and sanctuary.
Tall columns of fire erupt around the courtyard.
Tilt upward from her mechanical feet to her full silhouette. Keep her design clearly readable.

5.0–8.0 seconds — THE STOMP
She takes one sharp step forward and stamps her foot.
Close-up of the impact: a circular wave of flame races outward across the stone paving, forming a towering ring around her.
Cut to an aggressive low-angle shot, then a fast 180-degree camera orbit with a controlled Dutch angle.
At the exact moment of impact, the image suffers a short horizontal tear, RGB channel separation and block-displacement glitch. Nearby architecture briefly appears digitally misaligned, then snaps back.
Her anatomy and costume remain intact.

8.0–11.0 seconds — THE CLAP
Three rapid, precise inserts: articulated fingers approaching each other; the engraved mask; cables whipping behind her.
Electronic noise and image corruption intensify.
She brings both hands together in ONE decisive ritual clap.
On contact, a violent glitch pulse crosses the entire frame.
Immediately, every flame, ember and smoke plume freezes in midair.
Cut abruptly to a clean, sharp image. All sound drops into silence.
The fire remains volumetric and detailed, suspended like enormous sculptural shapes.
11.0–15.0 seconds — FROZEN INFERNO AND LOOP
The camera continues moving while the fire remains frozen.
Cut to a fast overhead arc showing the complete circular inferno and shrine courtyard, then cut low and push through suspended flames toward her mask.
The moving camera reveals strong parallax between frozen embers, her body and the sanctuary.
She slowly turns her masked face directly toward the lens.
Hold briefly.
